newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures fall on trade house selling.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures fall on trade house selling.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Friday, as selling by trade houses in the spot February contract spilled over into other months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.7 yen to 5.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark July was down 1.7 yen at 154.1 yen.

The yen's moderate rise against the dollar dampened market sentiment. Activity was lacklustre as the participation of private investors was limited ahead of the spot expiry next Monday. "The spot expiry could provide some direction to the market," one trader said.
